page.layout: One page of text, single column, with headings centred. No margin notes. Text runs from top to the closing "Laus Deo." Show-through from the reverse side is ignored.

main_text.p: R. Ad pœnitentiam et vitæ nouitatem. Vita enim Christiana noua vita est. Inserimur ergo per Baptismum Christo, et baptizamur in eius mortem, vt porrò mundo & peccatis mortui soli Christo viuamus.
main_text.head: DE COENA DOMINI.
main_text.p: R. Vt Christi mortem annunciemus & fratres diligamus.

page.notes: Transcribed from the scan. Headings are set in small capitals with the subtitle "DOMINI" in spaced capitals; the catechism Q/A lines are in italic type and the questions are roman with "I." and "R." markers. The line "Cur baptizamur?" in the first paragraph uses the printed question mark form. No catchword, signature, or page number is printed. Faint show-through from the reverse side (a Latin catechism text, partly visible in the right half of the page) has been omitted.
